question:
Choose the correct option to replace the underlined word/phrase in the following sentence:

The car is moving very __fastly __on the road.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e., **fast**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fastly"** is incorrect in standard English usage. It is often mistakenly used as an adverb to describe speed, but "fast" itself functions both as an adjective and an adverb. (यह शब्द मानक अंग्रेज़ी में गलत है।)

 
 
• **Example:** The car is moving very fastly on the road. (Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **"Fast"** refers to moving quickly or at high speed. It works as both an adjective and an adverb in English. (तेज़)
 
 
• **Example:** The car is moving very fast on the road. (Correct usage)
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word to replace "fastly" is **fast**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fastliness** (तेज़ी): This is not a valid English word.

 
 
• **Example:** Not applicable, as this word is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Quickliness** (जल्दबाज़ी): This is also not a valid English word.
 
 
• **Example:** Not applicable, as this word is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Quicker** (अधिक तेज़): It is a comparative adjective used to compare two entities in terms of speed.
 
 
• **Example:** The bike is quicker than the car.
